//: OPT-IN examples — NOT loaded by default. The active hooks.json ships empty
so the studio never writes to your knowledge base, and never runs commands,
without you asking. To enable either block below, copy it into hooks.json
SessionStart — keeps a LOCAL install on the latest studio. Refetches the
marketplace in the background at session start, so the NEXT session you open
is current; it cannot update the session it runs in, because agents and
commands register before hooks fire. Cloud sessions do not need this (they
install fresh from main at session start already). Skip it if you would
rather not have a network call on every session start — run
SessionEnd — a lightweight nudge to run /learn. Swap the echo for your own
reflection script for fully automatic capture.

hooks.command: command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 && (claude plugin marketplace update claude-code-studio >/dev/null 2>&1 &) ; exit 0
echo 'studio: session ended — run /learn to capture any lessons.' >&2
